name: ODOO-001 - Odoo Enterprise Instance Deployment & Infrastructure Setup
Description:
Deploy Odoo 16/17 Enterprise instance on cloud hosting / Kubernetes cluster with PostgreSQL database backend and SSL configuration. Expectation: Production and Staging instances online with secure secrets management.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Odoo Enterprise instance running with high availability PostgreSQL
- HTTPS enabled with valid SSL certificate
- Staging instance created and isolated from production
- Backup and restore procedures automated and verified

name: ODOO-002 - Core Standard Odoo Modules Activation & Configuration
Description:
Activate standard Odoo modules: CRM, Sales, Subscriptions, Invoicing, Events, Marketing Automation, Email Marketing, Helpdesk, Knowledge, Survey. Expectation: Standard workflows configured for Konn3ct terminology.

Acceptance Criteria:
- All 10 core modules installed and enabled
- Basic company details, currencies, and tax rules configured
- User access roles assigned for Sales, Support, and Finance teams
- Verified basic navigation and module accessibility

name: ODOO-003 - Custom Odoo Fields and Tags Configuration
Description:
Add custom fields and tags to CRM, Contacts, and Subscriptions models as specified in Volume 5. Expectation: Fields created via Odoo Studio/Python models for segmentation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Created custom fields: `x_konn3ct_user_id`, `x_account_status`, `x_current_plan`, `x_customer_health_score`
- Created custom tags: `Competitor Pain Signal`, `Upcoming Event Opportunity`, `Creator Monetization`, `Replay Demand`, `Payment Recovery`, `Renewal Window`
- Verified custom fields appear in Lead and Contact forms

name: ODOO-004 - Custom Addon: konn3ct_subscriber_sync Development
Description:
Develop custom Odoo addon `konn3ct_subscriber_sync` for bi-directional user and subscription state sync. Expectation: Exposes clean XML-RPC/REST endpoints for Konn3ct workers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Addon module structure created (`__manifest__.py`, models, controllers)
- Exposes API endpoints to create/update Contacts and Subscription records
- Validates API tokens on every sync request
- Idempotency check prevents duplicate record creation

name: ODOO-005 - Custom Addon: konn3ct_usage_intelligence Development
Description:
Develop custom Odoo addon `konn3ct_usage_intelligence` to ingest platform usage signals. Expectation: Updates user engagement score based on meetings hosted, replays watched, and AI notes generated.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Models created for tracking meeting usage, replay views, and AI summaries count
- Calculates composite `Customer Health Score` (0-100) dynamically
- Triggers alert task for account manager if health score drops below 40
- Unit tests written and passing for score calculation logic

name: ODOO-006 - Custom Addon: konn3ct_paid_events Integration
Description:
Develop custom addon `konn3ct_paid_events` extending `event.event` and `sale.order` for webinar ticket access. Expectation: Generates access tokens upon ticket payment.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Links ticket sale orders to Konn3ct room IDs
- Generates event access entitlement upon invoice payment confirmation
- Fires webhook to Konn3ct API to grant user room access
- Verified ticket purchase flow end-to-end

name: ODOO-007 - Custom Addon: konn3ct_replay_monetization Integration
Description:
Develop custom addon `konn3ct_replay_monetization` to track paid video replays, view access limits, and host revenue splits. Expectation: Accurately logs creator earnings.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Tracks paid replay sales and host revenue percentage split
- Generates monthly creator revenue summary reports
- Webhook integration to revoke replay access when expiry date passes
- Verified revenue calculations in Odoo Accounting

name: ODOO-008 - Custom Addon: konn3ct_partner_attribution Development
Description:
Develop custom addon `konn3ct_partner_attribution` to track ambassador referral codes and Country Hub operator commissions. Expectation: Automated commission calculation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Links referral codes to specific Partner/Ambassador Contact cards
- Automatically calculates commission amount on every invoice payment
- Tracks Country Hub regional revenue attributions
- Monthly partner payout summary report generated

name: ODOO-009 - 4-Tier Lead Scoring Engine Implementation
Description:
Configure Odoo automated lead scoring rules combining Fit Score, Intent Score, Engagement Score, and Revenue Potential Score (Volume 5). Expectation: Leads automatically tagged as Cold, Warm, Hot, or Strategic.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Scoring weights configured: Fit (25pt), Intent (25pt), Engagement (25pt), Revenue (25pt)
- Automated rule updates composite score upon signal ingestion
- Hot leads (Score >= 65) automatically assigned to senior salesperson
- Strategic leads (Score >= 85) trigger immediate email alert to Leadership

name: ODOO-010 - Marketing Automation Nurture Sequences Setup
Description:
Configure automated email and WhatsApp nurture sequences in Odoo Marketing Automation module. Expectation: Segment-specific campaigns for Free User activation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Onboarding 7-day email drip sequence for new signups
- Webinar attendance follow-up sequence with replay links
- WhatsApp template integration for high-intent leads
- Opt-out / Unsubscribe logic verified to comply with privacy rules

name: ODOO-011 - Abandoned Checkout & Payment Recovery Workflow
Description:
Configure Odoo automated workflow to detect failed payment webhooks and trigger recovery campaigns. Expectation: Automated reminders for abandoned checkout.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Triggers on `x_payment_status == Failed` or abandoned cart event
- Dispatches payment reminder email after 1 hour and 24 hours
- Generates support follow-up ticket for high-value enterprise accounts
- Tracks recovery success rate in Odoo CRM dashboard

name: ODOO-012 - Odoo Helpdesk SLA & Ticket Escalation Rules Setup
Description:
Configure Odoo Helpdesk module with SLA rules, priority mapping, and support team assignment. Expectation: Ticket priority mapped to user subscription tier.

Acceptance Criteria:
- SLA policies established: Paid Users (2-hour response), Free Users (24-hour response)
- Automatic ticket assignment based on issue category (Billing, Technical, Account)
- Diagnostic Snapshot JSON URL field added to Helpdesk ticket view
- Automated escalation rule triggers if SLA deadline is breached

name: ODOO-013 - Inbound Connector Worker Integration (Konn3ct -> Odoo)
Description:
Develop background message queue consumer in Konn3ct backend to push platform events to Odoo REST API. Expectation: Non-blocking, resilient sync queue.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Workers listen to `USER_REGISTERED`, `MEETING_CREATED`, `PAYMENT_SUCCESS` queue events
- Calls Odoo API endpoints with exponential backoff on network failure (5 retries max)
- Failed events logged to error queue for manual inspection
- Idempotency key checked to prevent duplicate creation

name: ODOO-014 - Outbound Webhook Handler Integration (Odoo -> Konn3ct)
Description:
Build API webhook handlers in Konn3ct to process state changes from Odoo. Expectation: Konn3ct entitlements update when Odoo subscription/invoice states change.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Webhook endpoint `/api/v1/integrations/odoo/webhook` verifies Odoo signing secret
- Processes `SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVATED`, `SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELLED`, `TICKET_RESOLVED` payloads
- Updates Konn3ct user access tokens and Redis entitlement cache immediately
- Returns HTTP 200 OK to Odoo webhook call

name: ODOO-015 - Primary KPI Executive Dashboards in Odoo BI
Description:
Configure custom reporting dashboards in Odoo to track Free Users, Paid Users, MRR, ARR, CAC, and LTV. Expectation: Executive-ready visual reporting.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Headline KPI tiles for Total Free Users and Total Paid Users
- Financial charts for Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) and Subscription Renewal Rate %
- Campaign ROI dashboard tracking conversion rate by lead source
- Exportable PDF/Excel executive reports configured
